title: Fix facilitator browser session exiting immediately on Start
description: Josh reports localhost:8096 feature dev session starts then immediately switches to session off. Investigate browser startup/audio/WebSocket boundaries and server logs without making model/provider calls; reproduce with mocks, add regression, fix, and restart isolated dev server. Reported CSP blocks embedded Waha fonts; verify actual asset policy separately.
notes:
Root cause found in client protocol: handleEvent(audio) sets runtime.audio but never calls existing beginOutput(..., true); playPCM then finds runtime.output null and releases the session. Added offline first-audio playback/ack regression. CSS contains two embedded data:font/woff2 faces; CSP omits font-src, so default self blocks them. Google/Pacifico/Roboto requests are absent from app source.
RED confirmed: correct buffered audio immediately released runtime.active; local embedded font check failed on default-src self. Reused beginOutput(event, true) to initialize validated legacy playback lifecycle; added only font-src self data for embedded fonts. GREEN: 135 offline Python tests, 4 Node client checks, Ruff, JavaScript syntax and diff checks pass. Restarted own dbs-facilitator-dev.service; localhost8096 health/page/JS/styles HTTP200 and served JS/CSP include both fixes. No live model/speech session started. Focused independent review and PR amendment pending.
close_reason: Fixed buffered audio startup state and embedded-font CSP. Reproduced both failures before changes; 135 offline Python tests, 4 client checks, Ruff, JavaScript syntax and diff checks pass. Independent review found no Important issues and reran all four client checks. Restarted isolated localhost8096 dev service; HTTP verifies corrected JS and font policy. Included in existing generative-facilitator PR #1; live voice trial remains with user.
